decision.why: The failed parent now identifies a concrete missing library, making one targeted repair more informative than another broad setup attempt. One experiment and 27 model calls remain. The earlier OCR candidate remains the best measured experiment for chord labels, but its zero parseable outputs and 100% melody error leave the goal unmet. Execution failure permits a direct debug branch.
decision.hypothesis: Missing GTK 3 is the immediate blocker to fresh Audiveris export; resolving it may enable measurable melody recognition, although subsequent runtime or transcription failures remain possible.
decision.expected_observation: Either verified GTK resolution enables a real MusicXML export and seven evaluable integrated predictions, or the bounded preflight exposes a specific remaining blocker. Any musical improvement must be established by subsequent protected evaluation.

config.approach: Install the specifically missing GTK 3 runtime and verify native-library resolution before a bounded Audiveris export preflight.
config.objective: Reproduce the inherited gtk-3 loading failure, install the distribution's GTK 3 runtime package and verify libgtk-3 resolves, recording package names and runtime versions. Retain Java 25 and Audiveris 5.11 plus unchanged OCR thresholds and melody conversion. Within 240 seconds obtain a genuine MusicXML export from one pilot image; stop with exact diagnostics if this fails. If successful, run the existing pipeline on all seven pilot images, independently validate complete kern outputs, and repair only parser-confirmed serialization defects. Preserve raw recognition outputs and chord bounding boxes. Do not fabricate notes or use references; mark chord timing unaudited.
config.success_criteria: Deliver native-library verification and either a real single-image MusicXML export or a reproducible failure report. If preflight succeeds, submit seven sealed predictions with per-image parsing diagnostics and actual-output upward-major-second transposition checks for melody, chord roots and slash basses. Protected evaluation should compare parseability against 0/7, melody errors against baseline 87/130 and prior experiments' 1.0 rate, and chord errors against the best experiment's 25/38 and baseline 30/38. Report regressions and untested cases explicitly; startup, parsing and synthetic checks do not establish musical correctness.

last_observation.summary: GTK native loading succeeded after rootless extraction of Debian 13 arm64 packages: libgtk-3-0t64 and libgtk-3-common 3.24.49-3, with libglib2.0-0t64 2.84.4-3~deb13u5. A fresh Python process loaded libgtk-3.so.0 and queried its runtime version. System installation was blocked by apt lock-directory permissions. The export wrapper then raised subprocess.TimeoutExpired after its remaining 3.4308305588069743 seconds; the original 240-second deadline expired at 240.016 seconds. No MusicXML export or kern predictions were produced. This verifies native loading through ctypes, not successful Java/Audiveris integration; no subsequent native blocker was established. Existing Java 25/Audiveris 5.11 configuration, OCR thresholds and melody conversion were retained. All seven required predictions remain missing and count as failures. Complete-output parsing and actual-output major-second transposition checks for melody, chord roots and slash basses remain untested. Chord timing remains unaudited. No musical improvement or regression rate was measured; the transcription goal remains unmet.

observation.note: Frozen worker output; only protected evaluation measures accuracy.
